brief: How I raised my consulting rate to $1,200/hour — 5 mindset shifts that made it possible.

slots.subtitle: How I raised my rate to $1,200 an hour by changing five beliefs about value.

slots.body: I once believed more hours meant more value. True leverage comes from solving in minutes what others take weeks to untangle.
Clients do not pay for your time; they pay for the transformation. When I anchored fees to results, objections became irrelevant.
Every no cleared space for a yes that matched my caliber. I stopped negotiating and started curating who entered my orbit.
High fees command high attention. The moment I tripled my rate, clients implemented faster, respected boundaries, and took the work seriously.
I learned to invoice before I felt ready. Trust in your own signal is the invisible line item that justifies premium pricing.
Availability is not a virtue. I built a quiet waiting list, and desire grew precisely because access was no longer guaranteed.
Your rate is a declaration of how you see yourself. Change the belief, and the number follows without resistance.
